feature_form: logit(P) = intercept + Σ coef[i]*feat[i] where feat = [pre_logit, gold_k, minutes, gold_x_minutes, pre_x_minutes, gold_x_underdog, gold_x_underdog_x_t, gold_sq]
usage: Build feature vector [pre_logit, gold/1k, minutes, gold/1k*minutes, pre_logit*minutes, gold/1k*(1-pre_prob), gold/1k*(1-pre_prob)*minutes, (gold/1k)^2] and apply sigmoid(intercept + dot(coef, features)). Valid for any minutes >= 10 (extrapolates poorly below).
